title: Pet — filter
description: A filter over Pet, in the JSON Query Language. Sibling members are combined with implicit AND, at every level. A bare scalar is equality: {"status": "open"} is {"status": {"$eq": "open"}}. Comparisons use three-valued logic: $ne and $not do NOT match records where the field is null or absent. To include them, add an explicit {"$isNull": true} branch under $or. $in compares the whole field value; it is not array membership. The element operators are $hasAny, $hasAll and $hasNone.
